board.title: Squad Board
board.description: The monotone board: eight columns for the issue, two terminals, the other entities beside the axis.

rules: A card's column is the furthest its work reached, and it never moves back. What holds a card now is a marker, never a move.
An attempt is a marker, not a move: the card leaves Gating only forward.
Closed means the wave is in dev.
A freeze is not a state. A frozen card keeps its column.
The columns are a view over kind and status, not a second axis.
A column's fact is an expression in one closed grammar: a fact name, all, any, not, and nothing else. Exactly one column answers the facts.

statuses.name: Backlog
statuses.description: Open, not in the schedule: no startable label, no live run, no freeze

statuses.name: Todo
statuses.description: Startable: no blocker, no live run

statuses.name: Doing
statuses.description: A live run holds it; a spec whose child is live work is marked here

statuses.name: Code Review
statuses.description: The child's code is done; its review or a fix round holds it

statuses.name: Code Complete
statuses.description: A child is in the wave branch

statuses.name: Gating
statuses.description: A gate or proof waits for a slot or runs for the wave; a red or unproven attempt is a marker, not a move

statuses.name: Abandoned
statuses.description: Not delivered, by decision: wontfix, superseded, or needs-info expired

kinds.name: Spec
kinds.fact: An issue carrying the spec label

kinds.name: TestCase
kinds.fact: A test pass with a result

kinds.name: PR
kinds.fact: A pull request, normalized for viewing

freeze.name: Owner
freeze.fact: frozen:owner - the owner is the next actor

freeze.name: Dependency
freeze.fact: frozen:dependency - another item gates this one
